blocks.text: Thin-layer chromatography (TLC) mein alumina (Al2O3) ya silica (SiO2) ko paani mein mila kar ghol (slurry) banaya jata hai, jo shishe ki slide par barabar phaila kar oven mein khushk kiya jata hai, jis se safaid thos teh, yani stationary phase, banti hai. TLC paper chromatography se tez hai.

items: Slide ke neeche pencil se seedhi baseline banayi jati aur capillary tube se us par sample ka dhabba lagaya jata hai; kai samples saath saath lagaye ja sakte hain.
Solvent chromatography tank mein dala jata aur slide us (mobile phase) mein is tarah duboyi jati hai ke baseline solvent ki satah se oopar rahe.

Ajza solvent mein ghulte aur alumina par mukhtalif had tak adsorb hote hain. Polar maadde polar thos ki taraf zyada khinchte aur aahista chalte hain; non-polar maadde non-polar solvent mein zyada ghul kar oopar tak jate hain. Is se yeh alag hote hain.

Jab solvent kaafi charh jaye to slide nikali, solvent front par nishan lagaya aur slide khushk ki jati hai. Dhabbon ki Rf qeematein nikal kar standard qeematon se milayi jati hain taa ke ajza pehchane jayein.
Be-rang ajza locating agent se nazar aate hain: ninhydrin amino acids ko jamni karta, kuch maadde ultraviolet roshni mein chamakte, aur kuch iodine ki bhaap se bhoore ho jate hain.

blocks.alt: Baen: do tank, shuru mein TLC plate jis ki baseline par solvent se oopar do sample dhabbe, aur taqreeban 10 minute baad wahi plate jis mein har sample dashed solvent front se neeche teen dhabbon mein alag. Daen: baalon ke rangon ka Quick Check chromatogram, A ka aik neecha dhabba, B ka aik ooncha dhabba aur C ke do dhabbe A aur B ki unchai par.
blocks.caption: Thin-layer chromatography aur baalon ke rangon ka chromatogram (Figure 28.4 aur Quick Check 28.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Solvent silica ya alumina ki patli teh mein charh kar har juzw ko mukhtalif faasle tak le jata hai. Aik hi plate par aik unchai ke dhabbon ka muqabla dikhata hai ke kaun se maadde aik hain: mixture ka jo dhabba khalis sample ki unchai se mile, ghaliban wahi maadda hai.

items: Na-maloom compounds ki Rf qeematein maloom standard qeematon se mila kar pehchan.
Reaction ki pesh raft dekhna: reactants khatam aur products ban rahe hain ya nahi.
Dawa aur khurak ki sanaton mein: dawaiyon ki safai aur khurak mein preservatives, rang aur meethe maaddon ki maujoodgi.
Mitti, paani, khurak aur hawa mein aaloodgi, keere maar dawaiyan aur zehreele maadde dhoondna.
Forensic science mein: jurm ki jagah dawaiyan, dhamake ka malba, khoon, paseena aur semen pehchanna.
Yeh zyada tar qualitative hai: maadde ki miqdar ka sirf andaza deti hai, durust paimaish nahi.
Qareebi Rf qeematon wale compounds ko saaf alag nahi kar sakti, is liye dhabbe hamesha tez nahi hote.
Sample ki sirf thori miqdar lagayi ja sakti hai; bare paimane par alag karne ke liye munasib nahi.
Yeh nami, darja hararat aur kaam ki jagah ki safai ke liye hassas hai, jo nataij ke dohraye jane ko kam karta hai.

blocks.prompt: Aluminium oxide stationary phase aur benzene solvent ke saath TLC se butanone aur pentane ka mixture kaise alag hoga?
blocks.explanation: Mixture ko baseline par laga kar plate ko benzene mein develop karein. Butanone polar (C=O) hone se polar alumina par zyada adsorb hota aur kam chalta hai (kam Rf); pentane non-polar hone se benzene mein zyada ghulta aur door jata hai (zyada Rf). Dono alag dhabbe bante hain, jo iodine ki bhaap ya UV roshni se dikhte hain.

blocks.prompt: TLC tajziye mein maadde X ki Rf qeemat maadde Y se zyada hai. Wajah batayein.
blocks.explanation: X mobile phase mein zyada ghulta aur/ya stationary phase par Y se kam adsorb hota hai (maslan X kam polar hai), is liye solvent ke saath zyada door jata hai.

blocks.prompt: Baalon ke rangon ke chromatogram (A: aik neecha dhabba; B: aik ooncha dhabba; C: A aur B ki unchai par do dhabbe) se teen nataij batayein.
blocks.explanation: A aur B dono ka aik aik dhabba hai, is liye har aik mein aik hi rang hai (ya khalis hai); C ke do dhabbe hain, is liye yeh mixture hai; C ke dhabbon ki Rf qeematein A aur B jaisi hain, is liye C mein A aur B hain; B ki Rf zyada hai, is liye yeh A se zyada solvent mein ghulta hai.

items: TLC: silica ya alumina ki teh (stationary), solvent (mobile); paper se tez.
Polar maadde polar alumina par kam chalte; dhabbe ninhydrin, UV ya iodine se.
Istemal: pehchan, safai, reaction ki pesh raft, khurak, aaloodgi, forensics; zyada tar qualitative.
